optimizer.name: free-vertex Adam candidate +8 backtracks + exact rollback + steepest restart
optimizer.fallback: after rejected Adam/contact line searches, use unpreconditioned -lr_max*gradient, same 8 backtracks and geometry guard; accepted gradient restart clears Adam moments and restores lr max, full rejection exact rollback
optimizer.contact_QP: not used: low-dimensional dense QP does not scale to thousands of XYZ coordinates

boundary.rule: w=0.1+0.9*(1-exp(-(d/8)^2)); d=min(distance to Background,distance to Ring) on original RGB label lattice; pixel-center EDT; no resized-mask distances

multiview_HERO: diagnostics after prediction freeze only; never optimization, weighting, selection or ranking
model_selection: last accepted state at fixed stop; no best checkpoint

trust.D_definition: maximum extent of retained INITIAL visible surface; no volume truth

initial_conditions: all nine cases; no historicalCameraGateexclusion; collisions recorded and cannot worsen
parameterization: per-vertex world-mm XYZ; cap rim tangent to inherited plane, inferred cap center follows rim mean

selection.score: equal-case gain of 0.5 recall_far_missing +0.5 recall -0.5 FP_per_Mask -0.02 boundary_MAE_px -0.02 raw_fixed_depth_cost
selection.choose: largest mean paired gain; tie within1e-5 prefer fewer terms; geometry never relaxed; no per-case winner
selection.minimum_general_evidence: positive gain in >=3/4 pilot cases, no case loss of recall>0.05 or raw depth cost increase>0.5; otherwise label mixed exploratory
selection.combined: best eligible loss and optimizer then one fixed verification; if no eligible optimizer use O0; no repeated grid

optimizers.O1: same directions/physics; lr floor .002 restart recovery and adaptive step trust floor tau/16 ceilingtau
optimizers.O2: sameO0; first40proposals project directions to shared sixparameter translation/axis-scale chart, then free vertices
optimizers.O3: sameO0; after full directions fail, deterministic top4 radius2edge local gradient patches, same full objective/physics
